visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person's hands using a metal peeler to remove the skin from a large, yellow-green apple on a dark brown cutting board in a brightly lit kitchen. (2) The hands then use a kitchen knife to slice the peeled apple into small, irregular wedges, piling them up on the board. (3) The apple wedges are placed in a transparent glass bowl, and a person pours white granulated sugar and adds cubes of yellow butter from a separate dish. (4) The mixture is poured into a black frying pan on a black induction cooktop, and the wedges are sautéed using metal tongs; a sprinkle of black specks is added. (5) A woman with dark hair pulled back, wearing a cream sweater, stands in a modern kitchen and opens a large white plastic container filled with risen dough. (6) On a marble-textured countertop, the woman uses a white scraper to divide the dough into many small, uniform round balls. (7) She flattens a piece of dough with her palm, places a spoonful of cooked apple filling in the center, and pinches the edges together to seal it into a ball. (8) The round dough balls are placed in a grey muffin tin, and a brush is used to coat them with a vibrant, deep purple liquid from a small metal cup. (9) A box of Glico Pretz sweet corn flavored biscuit sticks is shown; one stick is broken and inserted into the center of a purple dough ball to mimic an apple stem. (10) The tray is placed into a white microwave/oven combo; after baking, the buns appear golden-brown with purple blushes, and a green mint-like leaf is added next to the stem. (11) The final scene shows the apple-shaped buns being torn open by hand to reveal the steaming, chunky apple filling inside.

(5) In the final phase, the music remains uplifting as the narrator describes the joy and accomplishment of a successful bake. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a heartwarming lifestyle vlog and culinary tutorial. It uses the process of making apple-shaped bread to convey a mother's affection for her daughter while showcasing a creative and aesthetically pleasing recipe. The combination of detailed close-ups and personal narration creates an intimate, encouraging atmosphere for viewers interested in baking and family life.
